stem: A line remains highly heterozygous at many loci. What should a breeder expect when it is used to produce sexually derived offspring?
choices: More opportunity for alleles to segregate into different combinations among offspring
Guaranteed genetic uniformity among all offspring
No inherited variation because heterozygosity suppresses segregation
rationale: Heterozygosity means different alleles are present at loci, providing opportunities for segregation and recombination to generate variation among offspring.
